r: To develop and strengthen trusted relationships and sustain strategic dialogue with the clients up to all senior levels, particularly at the Minister level.
To originate and monetize business opportunities across the entire Citi’s product portfolio.
To drive thought leadership and content relevant to public sector clients’ needs and objectives.
To initiate and lead Public Sector initiatives that progresses the franchise’s objectives, performance, and market leadership.
To lead and mentor junior staff to develop their banking skills set and public sector knowledge.

The Public Sector Group (PSB) serves clients across the Developed and Emerging Markets that include Central Governments, Central Banks, Sovereign Wealth Funds, State Owned Enterprises (SOEs), and Development Financial Institutions (DFIs). Our Corporate Bankers build and grow our long-term relationship with these clients. They orchestrate the delivery of Citi's vast global product platform and develop integrated financing strategies, by acting as a primary point of contact through which our clients utilize our extensive capabilities around the world. Through these efforts, our bankers address our client's most complex global banking needs, helping them solve problems and realize opportunities.

PSB works with Banking, Services and Markets colleagues to develop innovative and viable solutions for our clients across the full spectrum of products such as fixed income, equity, all forms of derivatives, structured products, FX, export & agency finance, as well as securities and treasury Services. At the same time PSB works with Independent Risk Partners in the management of the bank's risk portfolio and in maximizing risk adjusted revenue and returns
Achieve sustainable revenue grow across the portfolio of public sector accounts in the region.
Implement calling plans to ensure business development is pursued across the entire client base.
Originate business opportunities leveraging the entire product portfolio.
Work with product partners to structure viable and replicable client solutions that are cost effective and scalable.
Work with Independent Risk to manage the portfolio and individual client risk and achieve targeted risk-adjusted returns.
Develop industry/segment specialization as appropriate and drive thought leadership and content.
Represent the Bank and the PS franchise at public forums and serve as speaker and subject matter expert at such forums.
Lead and mentor junior staff to develop their banking skills set and public sector knowledge.
Exposure to Senior Management and Senior Bankers throughout Citi’s extensive network
Opportunity to develop world-class broad-based banking and client relationship skills

Gain experience and insight into the risks and associated mitigation strategies in dealing with Public Sector.
